finding_dispositions.note: The tropology sentence now closes the Aquinas paragraph of interpretations 2.2 and names him ('Aquinas's tropology of the same verse is penitential ... These are Aquinas's words and no Father's'), with Venice 1745 p. 122. The Ambrose paragraph attributes only V.13's parenthesis to him and adds his own reading of the command at V.14 (the body lifted, the return to paradise, nothing of contrition or satisfaction), checked against the tracked transcription. Interpretations 2.2, 2.5 and 3.2 and scope 3.5, 4.2 and 4.3 were re-read against the c1834568c diff for other sentences moved under a different author. The only one found was interpretations 3.2's 'refuses exactly that', which now names Jerome and Ambrose. Scope 10.1 now bars printing Aquinas's tropology under any Father's name.
